title: Contract Specialist — U.S. Coast Guard
summary: This vacancy is for 4 GS-1102-13/14, Contract Specialists located in the United States Coast Guard's Assistant Commandant and Program Executive Office (PEO) for Surface Assets Contracting Directorate (CG-SEA-C). 1 GS-1102-14 and 1 GS-1102-13 are located in Helsinki, Finland. 1 GS-1102-14 and 1 GS-1102-13 are located in Rauma, Finland. $90,925–$139,684 per year
